svg.title: F33-3 Quick-reference sheet 3: controls, EPMS and network acceptance values
svg.text: about 60 Ω with two 120 Ω ends
What to prove on the record
1. Each calibration row gives the reference instrument, its accuracy and the difference against ±0.3 K.
2. Each meter check names the meter class, the reference analyser and the error on kW, V and I.
3. Each fibre result gives the loss at both wavelengths against the engineered budget.
F33-3 Quick-reference sheet 3: controls, EPMS and network acceptance values
BMS water temperature ±0.3 K · server failover ≤ 60 s · ION9000 kW ±0.3 % · SOE ±1 ms · EPMS completeness ≥ 99.5 % · fibre 0.75 dB per pair, 0.3 dB per splice · MRP 10 ms ≤ 14 switches
• EPMS data completeness over 72 hours passes at 99.5 % or more after back-fill with no device gap longer than 1 h.
• The loss budget uses 0.75 dB per mated pair (TIA-568.3-E) and 0.3 dB per splice (-D value).
